regions.name: window
regions.note: #menuWindow: Select a Server Type to Host, the five cards (outlined titles over downscaled photos). Box Office adds the Rent a Server card below the five (rent_servers_ui_chooser_card), so the window is 62 px taller and centred 31 px higher: the reference is cropped 31 px lower, and the rect stops above the Rent card (KN y 446). The card's 14 px top margin keeps that addition a whole 62 device px at the 1280x720 #uiBase scale (107 css px x 0.5796): with 15 px (108 css px = 62.6 px) the window moved a fractional 31.3 px, so its text snapped 32 px and its images and borders 31 px off the reference and no offset matched (4.9 % at 31, 3.5 % at 32 with the rect ending inside the Rent card)

regions.name: community-card
regions.note: the Community Games card: gamecats/c_0.png (525x168) at background-size: cover, centred, under the outlined title (v10 picks the banner at random; the capture and the scenario pin c_0). Box Office's Rent a Server card moves the window 31 px up (see window): the reference is cropped 31 px lower

regions.name: rent-card
regions.note: Box Office only: v7.1.4's Dedicated card (Rent a Server, img/host-bg/2.png), the way into 10.0.7's Rent Dedicated Server window, which 10.0.7's chooser lacks (deob-10.0.7.js:222239); kn-rent-regions covers the window it opens
